en: This is Verdant Cavern, the site of my trial. But a trial-goer needs the kahuna's blessing first: the festival in Iki Town!
Welcome, {player}! This is Verdant Cavern, and my trial begins here.
Pokémon have made dens in the cavern's walls. Look in all three and deal with whoever comes out. Then, at the very top, the totem Pokémon awaits.
No running from the totem, mind! I'll go in ahead and watch over you.
Hey, {player}! You're doing Ilima's trial? Take these, then. My grandpa says you can never have too many.
I'm gonna get a malasada and then I'll do the trial too. Probably. After a nap.
